## Changes

### New
- The comic page shows the alternative titles again, under the title (tap to see them all). They come split and cleaned up from every source: no "-", "Updating" or repeats of the title.
- Migrate and Import find more comics: a comic also matches by its other titles, so "Solo Leveling" finds MangaDex's "Na Honjaman Level-Up". When the title finds nothing, up to two other titles are searched.
- Bookmarks: search looks in every tab and in alternative titles, and the tab counts show the matches. Swipe the comics sideways to change tab.

### Fixes
- Zoomed in the vertical reader, the page now moves in any direction, not only up and down or sideways.
- Saving a page of a chapter that isn't downloaded no longer fails with "Couldn't save the image".
